predatory_indicators.description: Submission/contact email uses free webmail (gmail, outlook, yahoo, 163, qq, hotmail, protonmail)
Journal name contains generic prestige filler words (International Journal of Advanced/Modern/Innovative/World/Global/Universal/Excel)
predatory_indicators.test: title word density > 30% generic prestige words

predatory_indicators.description: Claims an impact factor but no Clarivate/Scopus listing can be verified
predatory_indicators.test: IF mentioned in manuscript but journal not in bundled legit list

predatory_indicators.description: Journal title not found in any legitimate scholarly index
predatory_indicators.test: title not in DOAJ, Crossref, or bundled legit publisher list

predatory_indicators.description: Publisher does not register DOIs / no Crossref membership
predatory_indicators.test: no DOI prefix in publisher metadata

predatory_indicators.description: No named editorial board or editor names are unverifiable
predatory_indicators.test: no editor/board mentioned in manuscript or metadata
no clear fee statement in manuscript or venue metadata

predatory_indicators.description: Manuscript mentions guaranteed fast acceptance, quick peer review, or submission incentives
Manuscript contains language matching aggressive journal solicitation emails
